home.heroTitle: Overlooking the Gulf of Salò, for three generations
home.heroSubtitle: Hotel Conca d'Oro overlooks the Gulf of Salò and welcomes its guests with passion and courtesy. The Bazzani family will be pleased to welcome you and make your stay a unique experience.
home.letterTitle: The hospitality of a family of restaurateurs
home.letterBody: For over fifty years the Bazzani family has carried on the specialities of Brescian cuisine and welcomed its guests with the passion and courtesy passed down through three generations of restaurateurs. Hotel Conca d'Oro overlooks the Gulf of Salò and is set just a few steps from the lake, in a wonderful position, with a large terrace fringed with palms and surrounded by a beautiful park.
home.letterClose: We look forward to welcoming you,
home.introTitle: A few steps from the lake, set in our park
home.introText: The rooms are cosy and well-kept, two terraces overlook the lake, and a beautiful park with playground for children and ample free parking are at our guests' disposal. Our private beach is across the road, with a garden, a kiosk, sunbeds and umbrellas, and direct access to the Gulf of Salò.

lake.title: Overlooking the Gulf of Salò
lake.text: The hotel overlooks the Gulf of Salò, about a five-minute walk from the historic centre. Our private beach is across the road, and from there the lakeside promenade runs along the entire Gulf.

restaurant.title: Brescian cuisine, a long tradition
restaurant.text: For over fifty years we have proposed the specialities of Brescian cuisine, paired with classic Italian dishes, in menus skilfully compiled by Chef Marco Bazzani and his qualified staff.

park.title: Park, terraces and beach
park.text: A large park with palms, two panoramic terraces over the lake, a playground for children, ample free parking and an exclusive beach with a kiosk open until late at night.

family.title: Family-run
family.text: Quality, care and excellence in product choice and service are guaranteed by the Bazzani family management. Augusto Bazzani personally coordinates the dining room with courtesy and care.

home.roomsTeaserText: Hotel Conca d'Oro offers 42 rooms, some with balcony with lake or park view. Each room has a large bathroom with shower and hairdryer, an LCD television with Italian and foreign channels, telephone and safe.
home.restaurantTeaserTitle: Brescian specialities and classic Italian cuisine
home.restaurantTeaserText: Traditional Brescian dishes are paired with classic Italian cuisine in important menus, skilfully compiled by Chef Marco Bazzani. The cooking is mainly local, with quality products linked to seasonality.

reviews.text: Impeccable hospitality, a family that makes you feel at home. Breakfast on the terrace is unforgettable.
reviews.author: Laura G.

reviews.text: Wonderful location, a few steps from the lake. The restaurant is a gem: authentic Brescian cuisine.
reviews.author: Markus W.

reviews.text: We come back every year. The palm garden and the private beach are a slice of paradise.
reviews.author: The Rossi Family

rooms.title: A stay between lake and tradition
rooms.intro: The 42 rooms of Hotel Conca d'Oro are cosy and well-kept, some with balcony with lake or park view. All rooms are provided with a large bathroom with shower and hairdryer, LCD television with Italian and foreign channels, telephone and safe.

Park with palms and children's playground
Four dining halls up to 600 guests
rooms.policy: Check-in from 2:00 PM, check-out by 11:00 AM. For late arrivals please get in touch — we will always find a tailored solution for you.

restaurant.title: Brescian cuisine, for over fifty years
restaurant.intro: Traditional Brescian dishes are paired with classic Italian cuisine in important menus, skilfully compiled by Chef Marco Bazzani and his qualified staff. The dining room service, based on courtesy and care, is personally coordinated by Augusto Bazzani.
restaurant.conceptText: Our cooking is mainly local, with quality products linked to seasonality. For over fifty years the Bazzani family has carried on the specialities of Brescian cuisine with the passion and courtesy of three generations of restaurateurs.
restaurant.menuText: The hotel has four large halls, modular and flexible, able to host up to 600 guests. Many solutions for banquets, receptions, business parties, celebrations, weddings and ceremonies.
restaurant.terraceText: The two terraces overlooking the Gulf of Salò are the perfect place for summer dinners, sunset aperitifs and breakfasts in the open air, framed by the palms that surround the hotel.

story.title: Three generations of restaurateurs on the Gulf of Salò
story.intro: For over fifty years the Bazzani family has carried on the specialities of Brescian cuisine and welcomed its guests with the passion and courtesy passed down through three generations of restaurateurs. Family management guarantees quality, care and excellence in product choice and service.
story.pullQuote: “Quality, care and excellence in the choice of products and of service are guaranteed by the management of the Bazzani family.”

timeline.title: Our start on the Gulf of Salò
timeline.text: The Bazzani family begins to carry on the specialities of Brescian cuisine, welcoming guests to the hotel a few steps from the lake, in a wonderful position with its large terrace fringed with palms.

timeline.title: The expansion and the four halls
timeline.text: The hotel grows: 42 cosy, well-kept rooms and four large modular halls able to host up to 600 guests for banquets, receptions, weddings and ceremonies.

timeline.title: The third generation welcomes you
timeline.text: Chef Marco Bazzani leads the kitchen with his qualified staff. Augusto Bazzani personally coordinates the dining room service with courtesy and care. The hospitality is still that of a family-run house.

values.title: Passion and courtesy
values.text: We welcome our guests with the passion and courtesy passed down through three generations of restaurateurs. We want your stay to be a unique experience.

values.title: Local and seasonal
values.text: Our cuisine is mainly local, with quality products linked to seasonality. The specialities of the Brescian tradition are at the heart of our offer.

values.title: Family management
values.text: Quality, care and excellence in the choice of products and of service are guaranteed by the direct management of the Bazzani family.

gallery.title: Glimpses of the hotel
gallery.intro: The hotel, the 42 rooms, the two lake-view terraces, the park with palms, the dining halls and the private beach on the Gulf of Salò.

contact.title: Write to us, call us, drop by
contact.intro: We will be happy to answer your questions and help you plan a tailor-made stay.

directions.text: A4 motorway exit Desenzano, then follow signs for Salò (about 15 minutes).
Desenzano del Garda railway station, then bus or taxi to Salò.
Verona Villafranca Airport (60 km), Bergamo Orio al Serio (85 km), Brescia Montichiari (55 km).
